# Gcore Object Storage

> Gcore Object Storage offers S3 and SFTP buckets with access control, presigned URLs, lifecycle policies, and CDN delivery.

- [Object Storage](https://docs.gcore.com/storage.md): Gcore Object Storage offers S3 and SFTP buckets with access control, presigned URLs, lifecycle policies, and CDN delivery.
- [Pricing and billing](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/how-storage-is-billed.md): Gcore storage pricing and billing covers S3 Standard, SFTP, and S3 Fast rates, plans, invoices, and plan changes.
- [Create and manage an object or SFTP storage](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/create-an-s3-or-sftp-storage.md): Create and manage Gcore Object Storage with S3 Standard, S3 Fast, or SFTP, including credentials, locations, and storage status.
- [Storage as a CDN origin](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/use-storage-as-the-origin-for-your-cdn-resource.md): Use Gcore Object Storage or SFTP Storage as a CDN origin, with public and private bucket connection modes and no egress billing.

## Manage object storage
- [Manage S3 access keys](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/manage-s3-access-keys.md): Create, delete, and rotate S3 access keys for Gcore object storage, including read-only keys and credential replacement.
- [Managing buckets](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/manage-buckets-via-the-control-panel.md): Create and manage Gcore Object Storage buckets, upload files, set CORS and access, copy file URLs, and add lifecycle policies.
- [Protect objects from deletion with Object Lock](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/protect-objects-with-object-lock.md): S3 Object Lock prevents object deletion or modification for a set retention period and must be enabled when creating a bucket.

## Configure AWS CLI, S3cmd, and AWS JavaScript SDK
- [Connect AWS CLI, S3cmd, and AWS JavaScript SDK](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/configure-aws-sli-s3cmd-and-aws-javascript-sdk/connect-aws-cli-s3cmd-and-aws-sdk.md): Connect AWS command line tools, S3cmd, and AWS JavaScript SDK to Gcore Object Storage using access keys and an endpoint.
- [Automatic object removal via AWS CLI](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/configure-aws-sli-s3cmd-and-aws-javascript-sdk/remove-objects-from-a-bucket-automatically-with-aws-cli.md): Gcore Object Storage lifecycle policies automatically delete objects after a set number of days using AWS S3 rules.
- [Configure access control on S3 storage with AWS CLI and S3cmd](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/configure-aws-sli-s3cmd-and-aws-javascript-sdk/configure-access-control-on-s3-storage-with-aws-cli-and-s3cmd.md): Configure S3 storage access control with ACLs and JSON policies using AWS command line and S3cmd.
- [Generate temporary links to files with AWS CLI and S3cmd](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/configure-aws-sli-s3cmd-and-aws-javascript-sdk/generate-temporary-links-to-files-with-aws-cli-and-s3cmd.md): Generate presigned URLs for temporary access to private files in Gcore Object Storage using AWS command line and S3cmd.
- [S3 service URLs and default region names](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/s3-service-urls-and-default-region-names.md): Find S3 service URLs and default region names for Gcore Object Storage Fast and Standard locations.

## Manage SFTP storage
- [FileZilla connection to SFTP storage](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-sftp-storage/connect-to-your-storage-with-filezilla.md): Set up a FileZilla SFTP connection to Gcore storage with password or SSH key authentication.
- [SSH key management for SFTP storage](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-sftp-storage/create-and-add-an-ssh-key-to-your-storage.md): Create and manage SSH keys for SFTP storage, including adding, listing, assigning, and deleting keys.
- [Request content directly from the storage](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/request-content-directly-from-the-storage.md): Find the correct URL format for requesting files directly from Gcore Object Storage or SFTP Storage, including hostnames and examples.
- [Check storages usage reports](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/check-storages-usage-reports.md): Storage usage reports show used space, requests, traffic, and object counts, with filters by period, type, location, and name.
- [Storage 4xx error troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/4xx-errors-how-to-solve-storage-issues.md): Fix Object Storage 404 and 403 errors by checking file uploads, request URLs, and setting public read ACL rules.
